source: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-3514-booklet.html (2025 Instructions for Form FTB 3514, California Earned Income Tax Credit — HTML booklet, including inline '2025 Earned Income Tax Credit Table')
notes: Complete table: 658 contiguous $50-increment bands from $1 to $32,900 ('At least X, But Not Over Y'; each band spans 49 above its min, e.g. 1-50, 51-100). Credits column order: [0, 1, 2, 3+ qualifying children]. Column maxima: $302 (0 QC, at 4,651-4,700), $2,016 (1 QC, at 6,951-7,000), $3,339 (2 QC, at 9,801-9,850), $3,756 (3+ QC, at 9,801-9,850). Includes the low plateau and the shallow second phase-out above $22,600: credits decline gradually to [1,1,1,1] in the final 32,851-32,900 band; credit is $0 above $32,900 (booklet: YCTC/FYTC 'completely phases out at $32,901'). FTB 3514 line 23b: no credit if federal AGI exceeds $32,900 or total net loss exceeds $35,640. Table values are FTB's rounded whole-dollar lookups; use the table, not the underlying formula. YCTC parameters confirmed from Step 8, Lines 25-27: subtract $27,425 threshold from CA earned income (Line 25); credit reduced $21.71 per full $100 over threshold (Lines 26-27); max credit $1,189. FYTC uses the same $1,189 / $27,425 / $21.71 parameters ($43.42 per $100 if both spouses claim FYTC). CalEITC worksheet AGI-lookup breakpoints confirmed (Worksheet Part 7/8: if line 3 (federal AGI) >= breakpoint for your QC count, look up credit by AGI instead of earned income): $4,661 (0 QC), $6,998 (1 QC), $9,823 (2+ QC).
